systemKey.description: ODCS `primaryKey`/`businessKey`/`required`/`unique` slot this flag fills on export; at most one flag per key project-wide.

phasingOut.description: Governance: the flag is being phased out — still allowed, but a column carrying it is a warning (`flag.phasingOut:<name>`). Absent = false.

phasingOutNote.description: Why the flag is being phased out, or what to use instead. Absent = none.
